# Colorado Foot Care Nurse

> Kirsten Antony, RN provides mobile foot and nail care plus separate complementary wellness services in the Denver metro area of Colorado.

## Essential facts

- Provider: Kirsten Antony, Colorado-licensed Registered Nurse
- Business name used for foot care: Heel Your Feet
- Phone: (303) 668-8992
- Email: kalacolorado@gmail.com
- Website: https://coloradofootcarenurse.com/
- Primary audience: seniors, adults with limited mobility, people who cannot safely reach or manage their feet, caregivers, assisted living communities, senior communities, and group homes
- Core service area: Denver, Highlands Ranch, Littleton, Centennial, Lone Tree, Parker, Castle Pines, and nearby communities
- Hours: Monday through Friday, 9:00am–5:00pm; limited Saturday appointments by request
- Payment: cash, check, or credit card

## Services and pricing

- Private in-home foot care: $85 per person, typically about 30 minutes
- Fingernail trim and file during a home visit: add $15
- Two foot care clients at the same location: $75 per person
- Clinic-style foot care for three or more clients: $50 per person
- Reflexology, Healing Touch, or sound healing: $150 per hour
- A $10 travel fee may apply outside the core service area

Foot care may include observation of the feet and nails, toenail trimming and filing, reduction of thick nails, gentle callus and corn care, care around ingrown or involuted nails when appropriate, education about hygiene and footwear, and referral guidance.

Complementary wellness sessions are offered separately for relaxation and wellbeing. They do not replace medical diagnosis or treatment.

## Provider background

Kirsten has worked in long-term care since 1994 and started her mobile foot care practice in 2001. Her background includes supervisor, charge nurse, and wound care nurse roles. Her listed education includes foot and nail care training through the Medical University of South Carolina and reflexology training through the Colorado School of Healing Arts, plus training in Healing Touch, HeartMath trauma-sensitive practice, sound healing, Quantum Field Healing, Laughter Yoga, and herbalism.

## Important scope note

This is not an emergency or urgent-care service. Mobile foot care does not replace a physician or podiatrist. New wounds, signs of infection, sudden swelling, or severe pain should be evaluated promptly by an appropriate medical professional.
